outcome: cerebral maturation indices measured by electroencephalographic (EEG) indices
maximal amplitudes of theta and delta bandwidths
cohort: Infants born less than 35 weeks postmenstrual age (PMA)
finding: Prenatal betamethasone treatment was associated with a possible stabilization effect on the central nervous system and a possible delay in the maturation of cerebral activity.
mod_finding: The relationship between prenatal betamethasone treatment and EEG indices was adjusted for mode of delivery in the analysis.
